title: 第11章 仙女奉命来双修要我亲自指导第12章 智慧女神陪我一起双修
content_zh:
我还没倒下，心口突然涌出一道温润内息，顺着经脉直达四肢百骸，瞬间把我从濒临昏迷的黑暗中拉了回来。
我还没完全站稳，香茹和芊纤已经一左一右握紧我的手。
她们神色平静，看样子早就认识这个“珍恋”。
“双舞姐姐，”香茹率先开口，语气沉稳，“按我们两宗的约定，你越界了。”
原来香茹早就认识她，那她肯定不是我的珍恋。
可她们为什么长得一模一样？连神态都分毫不差？
“哈哈！”仙双舞嗤笑一声，语气带着几分嘲讽，“你们两个早就破了身的宗门弃徒，还配代表圣女宫？”
“师姐们都在附近星域，我一念之间就能把她们召来。”香茹面不改色。
“那你尽管召来，我倒要看看，她们能奈我何。”仙双舞淡淡回应，满是不屑。
“你到底想怎样？”
“不想怎样。”仙双舞目光落在我身上，带着几分随意，“借你们男人用用，用完了完完整整还你们，少不了几两。”
“那你要按规矩来。”香茹寸步不让，“你得先叫我们一声‘姐姐’。”
“哦？”仙双舞愣了一下，眼神闪烁，“我今天胃口不好，改天吧。”
话音未落，她的身影已经出现在几千米外。
只见她随手一挥，一顶华丽的帐篷凭空闪现，她转身钻了进去，再也没了动静。
香茹松了口气。
我拉了拉她的衣袖，想趁着夜色悄悄离开。
她摇了摇头，示意我稍等，然后故意提高音量说了一句：“这里风光不错，我们就在这住几天再走。”
我心念一动，从“纳虚”中召出一栋别墅。
走进房间设置好隔音后，香茹才把事情的来龙去脉告诉了我。

这个女子名叫仙双舞，是“仙女宫”的圣女。
仙女宫和圣女宫向来水火不容，是死对头。
仙女宫表面是双修宗门，实则把男人当成消耗品。
被她们选中的目标，不仅会像“噬阳功”那样被吞噬灵体，连寿元、意识和天赋技能都会被一并吞噬。
她们的核心功法分为四部分：“噬灵功”吞噬灵体、“噬元功”吞噬寿元、“噬神功”吞噬意识、“噬魂功”吞噬天赋技能。
“噬灵功”和“噬阳功”不同，它吞噬的是灵体本源，就算对方没激活灵体，也能强行吞噬。
这种吞噬是相互的，能逆转。
双方争夺的结果，必然是弱者被强者吞噬。
只有一方主动让渡，才不会触发逆转。
所以这四门功法的本意是传承，由家族或师门先辈主动启动，把毕生修为毫无保留地留给后人。
仙女宫很久以前也是名门正派，后来掌握了以双修为引的强制吞噬秘法，能反过来吞噬比自己强大的人。
吞噬渐渐成了她们提升修为的主要途径，也就慢慢背离了正道。
圣女宫和仙女宫的恩怨，也因此愈演愈烈。
双方实力相当，为了避免无谓厮杀，后来达成了协议：圣女宫不干预仙女宫靠吞噬修行，仙女宫也不能主动掠夺男人，只能吞噬自己的双修伴侣。
可仙女宫很快就想出了对策。
她们乔装成其他双修宗门的弟子，引诱陌生男子缔结双修契约，再用秘法强行逆转吞噬。
很多男人心甘情愿被她们吞噬，因为他们以为找到了真爱，愿意为对方献出一切，包括生命。
是不是真爱，谁也说不清。
世间本就有以命相许的痴情，圣女宫根本没法界定干预。
没有绝对的把握，仙女宫弟子也不会轻易出手。

出手那就要留下一段生死相许的佳话。
如果男方有其他双修伴侣，就相当于多了一重天然保护，更难被吞噬。
圣女宫的“圣女玉佩”，更是能提供贴身守护。
所以香茹让仙双舞叫“姐姐”，就是在提醒她：香茹和芊纤都是我的双修伴侣，双重守护在身，让她掂量清楚再动手。
……
content_en:
Before I fell down, a warm inner breath suddenly surged from my heart, traveling along my meridians and reaching my limbs and bones, instantly pulling me back from the darkness on the verge of coma.
Before I could stand completely, Xiangru and Qianxian were already holding my hands tightly.
Their expressions were calm, and they seemed to have known this "Zhen Lian" for a long time.
"Sister Shuangwu," Xiangru spoke first with a calm tone, "According to the agreement between our two sects, you have crossed the line."
It turns out that Xiangru has known her for a long time, so she is definitely not my treasure.
But why do they look exactly the same? Even the look is exactly the same?
"Haha!" Xian Shuangwu sneered, with a bit of sarcasm in his tone, "You two abandoned disciples of the sect who have long since lost their virginity are still worthy of representing the Saintess' Palace?"
"The senior sisters are all in the nearby star field. I can summon them in one thought." Xiangru's expression remained unchanged.
"Then you can summon them, but I want to see what they can do to me." Xian Shuangwu responded lightly, full of disdain.
"What do you want?"
"I don't want to do anything." Xian Shuangwu's eyes fell on me, with a bit of casualness, "I'll lend it to you men, and I'll return it to you in full when I'm done with it, no less than a few taels."
"Then you have to follow the rules." Xiangru refused to give in. "You have to call us 'sister' first."
"Oh?"
Before she finished speaking, her figure had already appeared several thousand meters away.
She waved her hand casually, and a gorgeous tent flashed out of thin air. She turned around and got in, and nothing happened again.
Xiangru breathed a sigh of relief.
I pulled her sleeve and wanted to leave quietly under the night.
She shook her head, motioned for me to wait, and then deliberately raised her voice and said: "The scenery here is beautiful, we will stay here for a few days before leaving."
With a thought, I summoned a villa from "Naxu".
After entering the room and setting up the soundproofing, Xiangru told me the whole story.
This woman's name is Xian Shuangwu, and she is the saint of the "Fairy Palace".
The Fairy Palace and the Saint Lady Palace have always been incompatible with each other and are sworn enemies.
On the surface, the Fairy Palace is a dual cultivation sect, but in reality, it treats men as expendable items.
The target selected by them will not only be devoured by the spirit body like the "Yang Devouring Art", but also the longevity, consciousness and innate skills will be devoured.
Their core skills are divided into four parts: "Spirit Devouring Technique" to devour the spirit body, "Element Devouring Technique" to devour life essence, "God Devouring Technique" to devour consciousness, and "Soul Devouring Technique" to devour innate skills.
"Spirit Devouring Technique" is different from "Yang Devouring Technique" in that it devours the essence of the spirit body. Even if the opponent does not activate the spirit body, it can still swallow it forcefully.
This devouring is mutual and can be reversed.
The result of the competition between the two sides is that the weak will be devoured by the strong.
Only if one party voluntarily transfers will the reversal be triggered.
Therefore, the original intention of these four skills is to pass them on, initiated by the ancestors of the family or master, and to leave their lifelong cultivation to future generations without reservation.
The Fairy Palace was also a well-known and decent sect a long time ago. Later, it mastered the secret method of forced devouring using dual cultivation as a guide, and could in turn devour people who were stronger than itself.
Devouring gradually became their main way to improve their cultivation, and they gradually deviated from the right path.
The grievances between the Holy Maiden Palace and the Fairy Palace have intensified as a result.
The two sides were of equal strength, and in order to avoid unnecessary fighting, an agreement was later reached: the Holy Maiden Palace would not interfere with the Fairy Palace's practice of devouring men, and the Fairy Palace could not take the initiative to plunder men, but could only devour its own dual cultivation partner.
But the Fairy Palace quickly came up with a countermeasure.
They disguised themselves as disciples of other dual-cultivation sects, lured strange men into signing dual-cultivation contracts, and then used secret techniques to forcibly reverse and devour them.
Many men are willing to be devoured by them because they think they have found true love and are willing to sacrifice everything for each other, including their lives.
Whether it is true love or not, no one can tell.
There is already infatuation in the world that promises life, and the Holy Maiden's Palace has no way to define and intervene.Without absolute certainty, Fairy Palace disciples would not take action easily.
If you take action, you will leave a good story of life and death.
If the man has other dual cultivation partners, it is equivalent to an extra layer of natural protection, making it harder to be swallowed up.
The "Saint's Jade Pendant" of the Saint's Palace can even provide personal protection.
So when Xiangru asked Xian Shuangwu to call her "sister", it was to remind her: Xiangru and Qianxian are both my dual cultivation partners, and they are under double protection, so let her think carefully before taking action.
…
